description: Returns the sandbox's spendctl.yaml as text: the preset name and the agent's budgets, allowed hosts and approval rules. Use it to explain why a payment was refused or held, or to show what a spendctl policy file looks like. Read-only; the sandbox policy cannot be changed, create a sandbox with another preset instead.

sandbox_id.description: The sandbox_id returned by sandbox_create (32 hex characters)

name: get_policy
title: Show the sandbox policy
